inputs.text: The so-called democracy in Nigeria is nothing but a rigged facade, and the ruling APC is straight-up turning political parties into private clubs only the wealthy can join ahead of the 2027 elections. This is no random development or innocent change—it's a deliberate power grab by the hidden elites and institutions running the show, designed to shut ordinary people out of any real influence. They're inverting representation itself into a tool for total control, and we should dismiss all the surface talk about public service as the obvious distraction it is. This is just further proof that the whole system is coordinated from the top to keep power consolidated and the masses locked out.
